correctness.rationale: Quantifier-rank-two sentences are determined by the set of rank-one pointed types. On directed cycles these are (center,predecessor,successor,non-neighbour colours). Each binary cyclic factor occurs together with its reversal by maximal constant runs; reversal preserves non-neighbour support. Thus directed types are exactly recoverable from undirected types, uniformly for all lengths >=3. The opposite implication is quantifier-free. Distinct ternary orientations of a labelled triangle are separated by an explicit rank-two formula. The finite verifiers use two distinct representations and were executed from the packaged sources.

value.rationale: A motivated structural question—whether adding a coherent orientation changes rank-two first-order distinguishing power for coloured cycles—has an exact all-order answer and a sharp two-to-three colour boundary. The theorem provides same-depth elimination of directed edges at sentence level in the binary class, not merely a small enumeration.
